In 1977, Bharatiya Jana Sangh merges into Janata Party along with other parties. In 2014, BJP wins 282 seats under the leadership of Shri Narendra Modi, leading the NDA to a tally of 336 seats. He is sworn in as the 15th PM of India on 26th May, 2014. In 2019, BJP scripts history by winning 303 Lok Sabha seats on its own, and Shri Narendra Modi again becomes the PM.
